name: Cone Tracing
definition: Cone tracing is an extension of the sphere tracing algorithm used for signed distance field (SDF) rendering. It creates a cone that expands in the marching direction alongside the ray to provide useful intersection information with very little additional cost.
summary: Cone tracing approximates indirect lighting and soft shadows by casting expanding cones into a voxel grid, offering a computationally efficient alternative to full path tracing.
